Recipe “Stake 1,000 SOS”: 1000 SOS → stake-receipt, 2 a day.
Recipe “Withdraw 1,000 SOS”: stake-receipt (kept) → 1000 SOS, 2 a day.
Pool “sos-deposits”: 2000 SOS in and 2000 out a day from a seed of 0; it holds steady.

explanation:
SOS Launchpad: 2 tokens, 2 items, 1 pool, 2 recipes. The project’s currency is SOL (SOL). It runs on the shared loot program, devnet only: no contract of its own.
Asked for: “People stake SOS for seven days to reach the 1,000 tier. Only wallets with at least 1,000 SOS still deposited can buy a Founder Pass NFT for 0.01 SOL, one per wallet. No reward pool, seed, emissions or free SOS. Use refundable 1,000-SOS deposits and wallet-bound single-use receipts.”

What players do, what it costs and what it is worth
- Buy “Founder Pass”: 0.01 SOL, about 0.015105 SOL in all (the price, the player fee, the network, the collectible’s rent, which never comes back); only players who show a “stake-receipt” whose used is “0” can buy it. The money: all of it to your treasury.
- Craft “Stake 1,000 SOS”: 1000 SOS → stake-receipt (+ 0.002 SOL player fee).
- Craft “Withdraw 1,000 SOS”: stake-receipt (kept) → 1000 SOS (+ 0.002 SOL player fee).

How the pools fill and drain
- “sos-deposits” (SOS): starts at 0; in: recipe:stake-sos 2000 a day; out: recipe:unstake-sos 2000 a day; it holds steady.

What setting it up costs
- About 0.014554 SOL in all, in 2 transactions (1 wallet approval): rent 0.014534 SOL for 11 accounts, program fees 0 SOL, network fees 0.00002 SOL.
- Accounts marked “about” are sized roughly (a Core collection or an external token account).
- The network fee is 5,000 lamports a signature; a wallet may add a priority fee of its own.

Each day, if 2 × recipe:stake-sos, 2 × recipe:unstake-sos, 2 × item:founder-pass happen (anything else 100)
- Players pay 0.02 SOL, 2000 SOS and get back 2000 SOS on average, plus 0.012 SOL in player fees.
- Your treasury gets 0.02 SOL; burned: nothing; the platform’s fees: 0.012 SOL.

Know before going live
- Every purchase of “Founder Pass” also pays the platform’s player fee of 0.002 SOL: 20.0% on top of its 0.01 SOL price. Fine for a game; a higher price makes the fee a smaller part of it.

Devnet only: nothing here is real money. Going live is your approval in your own wallet: no one else signs, and no key is ever shared.

publish.text:
Going live: 2 transactions, 1 wallet approval, about 0.01455388 SOL on devnet:
1. Make the token SOS (6 decimals) with a fixed supply of 1000000, all of it to your wallet, then turn its minting off for good
2. Make the collection “SOS Founder Collection”, with 0% resale royalty to you; the project may mint into it
3. Open the project on the loot program with its collection; your wallet signs its decisions, and your wallet is its treasury
4. Open the pool “sos-deposits” for SOS
5. Write the item “1,000 SOS Stake Receipt”
6. Write the item “Founder Pass”
7. Put “Founder Pass” in the shop at 0.01 SOL
8. Write the recipe “Stake 1,000 SOS”
9. Write the recipe “Withdraw 1,000 SOS”

To put it live, the person runs this in a terminal in the project folder (not you): npx -y @gamesfun/loot approve loot.json
It opens a page on their own computer; they connect a wallet set to devnet and approve. What lands is written back into the file.
